fomod.Name: OStim Together
fomod.Author: OStim Together project
fomod.Description: Synchronizes OStim Standalone scenes through Skyrim Together Reborn. v0.37.6 adds compatibility with OStim Standalone 7.5c / OStim.dll 7.5.0.3 after verifying that its GraphActor prefix remains compatible with the validated OStim 7.5b layout used by OStim Together's read-only graph probes. Core scene synchronization, Threads ABI v3 handling, PPA support and OCum RaceMenu overlay support are unchanged. OCum's 3D vaginal and anal equip-object meshes remain intentionally unsupported on remote STR player proxies.
